why_this_exists: a boss ruling is not a verdict but a set of CONSEQUENCES, and this campaign had no place where each consequence carried an executed/declined mark. B3-1's condition was half-executed and B3-2 was not executed at all, both for that reason. Ordered by the second OW-6 stage-2 final check.
